items.title: Getting Started Guide
items.description: Build one Notes application on the runtime, then add optional agent, delivery and operations capabilities.

items.title: Ch 1: Send Your First Event
items.description: Send a named input, read the durable Event and wait for settlement.

items.title: Ch 2: React With a Processor
items.description: Run a Processor for every matching Event using its resolved data.

items.title: Ch 3: Keep State in a Collection
items.description: Store notes as schema-checked records and read the facts each write appends.

items.title: Ch 4: Share Operations as Actions
items.description: Move the note write into a validated, recorded notes.save Action.

items.title: Ch 5: Package a Plugin
items.description: Bundle the Notes primitives into a plugin and keep host choices in one composition.

items.title: Ch 6: Test and Inspect
items.description: Test the plugin in isolated in-memory apps on Deno and Node and read diagnostics.

items.title: Ch 7: Persist and Recover
items.description: Keep notes on disk, reopen in a new process and replay an earlier operation.

items.title: Ch 8: Hello Agent
items.description: Optional: compose the Core harness with one model and stream an agent reply.

items.title: Ch 9: Grant Tools
items.description: Optional: present notes.save and a clock to the assistant as granted tools.

items.title: Ch 10: Connect Existing APIs and MCP Servers
items.description: Optional: turn OpenAPI and MCP resources into grantable Actions and Tools.

items.title: Ch 11: Package Instructions as Skills
items.description: Optional: move reusable instructions into a Skill loaded only when needed.

items.title: Ch 12: Collaborate With Specialists
items.description: Optional: add a reviewer agent and let the assistant ask it questions.

items.title: Ch 13: Remember Across Conversations
items.description: Optional: keep curated, provenance-aware memory beside conversation history.

items.title: Ch 14: Test Agents Without a Provider
items.description: Optional: check the agent harness deterministically with a scripted LLM Adapter.

items.title: Ch 15: Expose an HTTP API
items.description: Serve notes.save through an explicit Fetch boundary with a host-owned listener.

items.title: Ch 16: Authenticate and Isolate Tenants
items.description: Map verified principals to tenants and owners, and authorize each request.

items.title: Ch 17: Connect Chat and Channels
items.description: Put the assistant behind the authenticated HTTP boundary with Core routes.

items.title: Ch 18: Handle Files and Large Content
items.description: Store file bytes once as a scoped Asset referenced by a note.

items.title: Ch 19: Schedule Recurring Work
items.description: Turn host clock ticks into durable occurrences that save digest notes.

items.title: Ch 20: Measure Model and Tool Usage
items.description: Optional: record a Usage ledger row per model attempt and tool call, and read analytics.

items.title: Ch 21: Deploy and Scale
items.description: Split the app into a Gateway and Worker sharing persistence and transport.

items.title: Ch 22: Organize, Share and Evolve Plugins
items.description: Move declarations into per-primitive files and generate a static plugin module.
